rounds.prompt: Which tense goes with each time expression?
rounds.note: Unfinished time or no time → present perfect · finished time → past simple.

rounds.prompt: Which verbs are rarely used in the continuous?
rounds.note: State verbs describe states, not actions, so they rarely take -ing.

rounds.prompt: Continuous or perfect?
rounds.note: Continuous = be + -ing · perfect = have + past participle.

rounds.prompt: Past or future?
rounds.note: The first auxiliary carries the time: had/was → past, will → future.

rounds.prompt: Finished, or still going on?

rounds.note: Present perfect → a result · present perfect continuous → an activity, perhaps unfinished.
